source: Ohnaka et al. (2019), ApJ 883, 89, Section 3.1, power-law limb-darkened disc fitted to the VLT/AMBER continuum (https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.06997)
band: VLT/AMBER K-band continuum near 2.3 um; not a visible band

alpha.cell: "We obtained a limb-darkened disk diameter and a limb-darkening parameter of 51.18 +/- 2.24 mas and 0.61 +/- 0.24, respectively, in the continuum"

note: I(mu)/I(1) = mu^alpha (Hestroffer 1997), the mean over the continuum channels with the mean of their bootstrap errors, as the paper describes. The only measured limb of R Dor; the visible limb is not measured.
